name: executive-frame-client-hub
description: Executive Frame Client Hub: in treatment web app for clients of Sarah Anticich. Static HTML, CSS and JavaScript on Firebase.

scripts.check: npm run test:unit && npm run contrast
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --project demo-clienthub --only firestore,storage "node --test tests/rules.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && npm run test:rules
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run check && firebase deploy --project executiveframe-app --only hosting:clienthub
